headline: China to lower domestic gasoline and diesel prices
summary: China will lower domestic gasoline and diesel prices because of falling oil prices on the international market, Xinhua reported. The adjustment follows the country's fuel pricing mechanism.
why: China adjusts retail fuel prices periodically to track international crude prices. Fuel costs feed into transport, logistics and inflation across the Chinese economy.
